Label: local donor ID
Definition: An identifier that uniquely denotes objects only within the scope of a specific object aggregate and that is not registered in an identifier registry. [Allotrope]

Label: repository
Definition: Repository' trailing modifier (qualifier, 'repository') of 'xref' links of 'Format' concepts. When 'true', the link is pointing to the public source-code repository where the given data format is developed or maintained. [EDAM]

Label: donor source
Definition: The origin of the donor/subject in this experiment.

Label: ethnicity
Definition: Population category defined in terms of cultural, religious, tribal or other social similarities. [EFO]

Label: race
Definition: An arbitrary classification of a taxonomic group that is a division of a species. It usually arises as a consequence of geographical isolation within a species and is characterized by shared heredity, physical attributes and behavior, and in the case of humans, by common history, nationality, or geographic distribution. [ExO]

Label: sex at birth
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved. [PATO]

Label: gender at time of death
Definition: Identification as male/masculine, female/feminine or something else, and association with a (social) role or set of behavioral and cultural traits, clothing, etc; a category to which a person belongs on this basis. Gender is the result of a complex combination of gender role, gender expression, gender identity, and gender modality. Do not use this term for non-human animals. [NCIT]

Label: sexual orientation at time of death
Definition: The pattern of a person's emotional, romantic, and/or sexual attractions. [NCIT]

Label: age value (years)
Definition: A time quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of how long the bearer has existed. [PATO]

Label: birth country name
Definition: The name of the country where a subject was born. [NCIT]

Label: primary language code
Definition: The alphanumeric code from the ISO 639 standard which denotes the primary lanugage of a subject. The ISO 639 standard includes a two letter representation and a three letter representation. [NCIT, modified]

Label: secondary language code
Definition: The alphanumeric code from the ISO 639 standard which denotes the secondary lanugage of a subject. The ISO 639 standard includes a two letter representation and a three letter representation. [NCIT, modified]

Label: autopsy report
Definition: A document assembled by an author for the purpose of providing information regarding the cause of death of a subject for the audience. [IAO, modified]

Label: cause of death
Definition: The circumstance or condition that results in the death of a living being. [NCIT]

Label: cause of death code
Definition: The ISO code that denotes the circumstance or condition that results in the death of a living being. [NCIT]

Label: manner of death
Definition: The manner of death is the determination of how the injury or disease leads to death.  There are five manners of death (natural, accident, suicide, homicide, and undetermined).

Label: informant questionnaire completed
Definition: The status (completed, not completed) of the document about the subject completed by an informant.

Label: informant interview performed
Definition: The status (performed, not performed) of the interview event between a clinician and an informant.

Label: informant relationship
Definition: The relationship that a informant bears to a subject/donor.

Label: handedness
Definition: A behavioral quality inhering ina bearer by virtue of the bearer's unequal distribution of fine motor skill between its left and right hands or feet. [PATO]

Label: medical records available
Definition: The status (available, unavailable) of the medical records of the subject/donor.

Label: medical records reviewed
Definition: The status (reviewed, not reviewed) of the medical records of the subject/donor.

Label: hemisphere
Definition: One of two bilateral, largely symmetrical organ subdivisions within the telencephalon which contain the cerebral cortex and cerebral white matter. [UBERON]

Label: post mortem interval
Definition: The length temporal interval between the time of death of the subject/donor and the time at which the specimen is made.

Label: left hemisphere preparation
Definition: The type of preparation method used for the left hemisphere.

Label: left hemisphere preparation specify
Definition: Specific details about the type of preparation method used for the left hemisphere.

Label: left hemisphere tissue inventory
Definition: The inventory (list) of the tissue samples for a specific left hemisphere specimen.

Label: left hemisphere tissue sampling history
Definition: The history of the tissue sampling for a specific left hemisphere specimen.

Label: right hemisphere preparation
Definition: The type of preparation method used for the right hemisphere.

Label: right hemisphere preparation specify
Definition: Specific details about the type of preparation method used for the right hemisphere.

Label: right hemisphere tissue inventory
Definition: The inventory (list) of the tissue samples for a specific right hemisphere specimen.

Label: right hemisphere tissue sampling history
Definition: The history of the tissue sampling for a specific right hemisphere specimen.

Label: RIN
Definition: The RNA integrity number value of a specimen.

Label: RINe
Definition: A type of RIN (RNA integrity number) value that represents the relative ratio of the signal in the fast zone to the 18S peak signal fpr a specimen.

Label: pH
Definition: The value of a measurement of acidity or basicity of a tissue, sample, or specimen.

Label: brain weight measurement
Definition: The weight of a brain specimen.

Label: brain tissue weighed type
Definition: The state of a brain specimen when it is weighed (fresh, frozen, fixed).

Label: photo 2d available
Definition: The status (available, unavailable) of two-dimensional photos of a subject/donor/specimen.

Label: scan 3d available
Definition: The status (available, unavailable) of three-dimensional scans of a subject/donor/specimen.

Label: antemortem MRI available
Definition: The status (available, unavailable) of antemortem MRI images of a subject/donor/specimen.

Label: postmortem MRI available
Definition: The status (available, unavailable) of postmortem MRI images of a subject/donor/specimen.

Label: postmortem MRI type
Definition: The type of postmortem MRI that is available (cadeveric, fresh ex vivo, fixed ex vivo).

Label: anatomical atlas registration
Definition: The anatomical atlas structure to which a specimen/tissue is registered.

Label: gestational age value (weeks)
Definition: The gestational age of the subject/donor in weeks.

Label: gestational age value (days)
Definition: The gestational age of the subject/donor in days.

Label: gestational age value (months)
Definition: The gestational age of the subject/donor in months.
